name: 30062 · Marietta, GA
findings: ZIP 30062 (Marietta) has 294 nonprofit organizations. 126 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 101 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30062 (Marietta) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
